description: This file defines a 'Shop' component for a shopping application frontend, utilizing LightningJS components and theming. It manages UI layout, subscribes to cart state updates, and provides a method to toggle the cart panel.

classes.name: Component (from Blits)
classes.description: A LightningJS component that represents the shopping page UI layout and behavior.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes reactive state properties for the component including theme colors, product list, cart count, total, and visibility.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Lifecycle hook executed when component is ready; subscribes to cart store updates and initializes count and total.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Lifecycle method to clean up subscriptions when component is detached from the DOM or destroyed.

methods.name: $toggleCart
methods.description: Method to toggle the visibility of the shopping cart panel.
